chapter_thought_ja: 住める場所と、辿り着ける場所は違う。

architecture_strengths: Camtrap DP separates deployment effort from animal observations by resource semantics
multi-year camera deployments with coordinates and start/end effort intervals
observation process is distinct from the two current favorable acoustic-telemetry/passive-acoustic endpoints

frozen_candidate_universe.architecture_limit: analysis-ready response-independent repeated-node/effort closure is less directly standardized in source metadata
source separation is attractive but observation process is less heterogeneous relative to the already favorable King Rail endpoint

selection_reason: MICA has the strongest response-blind combination of standardized deployment/observation separation, explicit repeated camera effort, public coordinate geometry, multi-year coverage, stable public source identity, and observation-process heterogeneity. Selection does not use muskrat prevalence or any EOG outcome.

focal_taxon.selection_rule: first focal invasive mammal named by the MICA monitoring project/dataset title and objective; do not switch species after any response access

non_event_semantics: adequately active camera-location week with no recorded muskrat detection under the frozen effort rule; not biological absence

calendar_split.calibration: ISO weeks with week start before 2022-01-01
calendar_split.heldout: ISO weeks with week start on or after 2022-01-01

hard_stop: a valid third predictive terminal result ends fresh endpoint development; no fourth endpoint
